 No designation for Patrick Mahomes in Week 9
 Tim Piotrowski, USA TODAY 2026년 11월 7일 토 오전 1:19 UTC 0 Kansas City Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes (knee) fully participated in practice Friday, Nov. 6, and is not on the injury report for Week 9.
 Advertisement
 SOURCE: Chiefs.com 
 Why It Matters: Mahomes is coming off a terrific Week 8 performance and has thrown for at least two touchdowns five times this season. He is not posting the same numbers he did in the past but can be considered a high-end No. 2 quarterback in fantasy leagues.
 This article originally appeared on USA TODAY: No designation for Patrick Mahomes in Week 9
